confirm.title: Stop the process on port {port}?
confirm.text: The process {name} (PID {pid}) is listening on port {port}. Command:
confirm.via: It was started by DevDock ({owner}): it is stopped from there.
errors.not_listening: No process with PID {pid} is listening on port {port}: refresh the list
errors.self: It is DevDock itself: it can't be stopped from here
errors.not_owner: The process belongs to the user {user}: only your own processes can be stopped
confirm.forceHint: Stop asks the process to exit (SIGTERM). Force stop kills it immediately (SIGKILL), without giving it time to save or release resources.
confirm.forceHintWin: Stop asks the process to exit. Force stop kills it immediately (taskkill /F).
stillListening: Port {port} is still in use: the process did not exit. Force it to stop?
stillListeningForced: Port {port} is still in use even after the forced stop
